bug_semantics: mj-include resolves attrs.path with path.resolve(cwd, file) then fs.readFileSync with no confinement. Missing files become a comment that includes the attempted path, so traversal can test existence. type=css/html (handleCssHtmlInclude) injects file bytes into output, so the same path can read files. ignoreIncludes defaulted to false, so the CVE-2020-12827 opt-out did not close the sink.
